members.name: selection
members.description: Field to use for retrieving data, or Table to use for retrieving record numbers

members.name: array
members.description: Array to receive field data or record numbers

params.description: If present, defer execution of this statement and stack it with other SELECTION TO ARRAY(...; *) lines until a final call without *.

overloads.semanticRole: Copies field values or record numbers from the current selection into one or more parallel arrays (in selection order); the optional trailing * defers execution so several such statements can be stacked and run together.

constraints: Each array is typed according to the source field's type; loading record numbers (via the [table];array syntax) produces a Longint array.
Values can be loaded through several levels of a Many-to-One relation (automatic, or manual made automatic via SET AUTOMATIC RELATIONS), reading the related field's values.

If an array was already explicitly typed (e.g. via ARRAY LONGINT) before the call, SELECTION TO ARRAY does not retype it even when loading from a Time field; it keeps loading data coerced into the array's existing type.

Passing the trailing * defers execution: 4D stores the statement in memory instead of running it immediately, letting several SELECTION TO ARRAY lines (like QUERY) stack up and execute together as one final call without *; the command can therefore also be called with no parameters at all to run the stacked lines.
